From: Marcela Escobari <[contact omitted]>
Date: Friday, July 22, 2022 at 9:54 AM
To: Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Alexander Brockwehl <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Follow up
Hi Brian, and thank you for reaching out. I will follow up to find a time to connect. Our bureau remains
focused on these issues and interested in our partnership.
Best,
Marcela
On Tue, Jul 19, 2022 at 9:24 AM Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Marcela - not sure if you or your team were able to join our call last Friday to cover the work that our
Trust and Safety team does across the company, but wanted to circle back with you individually to
hopefully follow up on the conversation we started at the Summit. We are meeting with Michael Camilleri
on Friday to do a deeper dive on our work in the Northern Cone. As a next step l'd love to gather our
teams inthe US and LatAm for a conversation about how we might move ahead with a partnership to
address the concerns you and the Administrator have raised with respect to misinformation.
Would it make sense to schedule time next week?
Thanks,
Brian
From: Brian Rice < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Friday, June 17, 2022 at 2:58 PM
To: Marcela Escobari <[contact omitted]>, Alexander Brockwehl <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Follow up
Great—look forward to connecting soon. We will see if we can consolidate and cover as much as we can
with one briefing, unless you tell us it's helpful to meet separately on any of the issues raised.

From: Marcela Escobari <[contact omitted]>
Date: Wednesday, June 15, 2022 at 2:13 PM
To: Alexander Brockwehl <[contact omitted]>, Brian Rice • [contact omitted]>
Cc: Sandra Luff < [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Follow up
Likewise! Your name came up again when discussing migration misinformation driving more people to
make the trek through the Darien gap. Thanks,
M
On Wed, Jun 15, 2022 at 2:08 PM Brian Rice < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Marcela,
It was great to meet last week in LA. I'm sure the rest of your week was busy—would love to follow up
on our conversation from breakfast about how we are approaching misinformation in the region. I also
know we are working with Michael C. to schedule a briefing for later this month—happy to work to
combine our conversations or to meet with you separately. Either way—look forward to connecting
Esignature_678030573
Brian Rice |
